links.outcome: Clinical goal achievement after planner manual adjustment of DL plans
links.effect: Clinical goal achievement rose from 91% to 93.6% (CTV therapeutic) and 78.2% to 88.5% (CTV elective); NTCPs significantly but slightly reduced (p < 0.001).
links.quote: Manual adjustments resulted in an increase of clinical goal achievement from 91% (sDLO, n = 71) to 93.6% (mDLO, n = 73) in CTV therapeutic and 78.2% (sDLO, n = 61) to 88.5% (mDLO, n = 69) in CTV elective ( Fig. 1 , Supplementary Table S4).

links.outcome: Periodic benchmark of every fifth DL plan against blinded manual plans
links.effect: Manual plans met all clinical goals in 16/16 vs mDLO 14/16; mDLO had lower spinal cord (30.3 vs 33.2 Gy) and parotid dose (15.8 vs 16.9 Gy).
links.quote: All clinical goals were met in manual plans for all patients ( n = 16) in the benchmark cohort, while mDLO plans reached all clinical goals in 14/16 patients (Supplementary Table S4).
